'''Ithorese''' or '''Ithorian''' was the language of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]]. Because the Ithorians had two mouths and four throats, the language had a peculiar stereophonic aspect to it. This stereo effect also appears when Ithorians speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. The language was incredibly difficult to learn.

{{Language-stub}}

==Known phrases==
*''N'ygyng m'thune vned "isobec" k'chuv "ysobek."''<ref name="Lovers" /> — The word for "love" in one language is the word for "dinner" in others. (Proverb; loose translation)
